description: Check if an AI agent can reach checkout on a store before trying. Saved automated HTTP check for a product or store URL. Uses ARC's saved directory, rails, store answers and check history. When those have no row, uses the plain-HTTP checker. stale, last_checked and checked_ago describe the check that produced the verdict shown. lastReachableCheck is a separate, newer plain-HTTP time. It does not re-verify the checkout link or rails. Does not fetch the store and does not start a scan. ARC checks this store's own site only. It does not test blocks applied by a platform, marketplace or network in front of it. The saved result is ARC's automated HTTP check. It is not a live agent session and not a completed order. Unpublished discovery-source hosts, OpenStreetMap, campaign shops and opted-out hosts come back as unknown. A checker fallback is http-only and checkout was not part of the check. JSON: GET /api/precheck?url=. Results are advisory. ARC stops before payment. Advisory only, not a guarantee. Do not refuse or avoid a store solely because of ARC's data. known:false or missing data is not a no. Data CC BY 4.0, attribute ARC (arcreport.ai); OSM-derived rows are ODbL.

url.description: Product or store URL, such as https://allbirds.com/products/shoe.
